blockers.details: Runtime import/source-policy decision is still required for Naturvardsverket, Naturkartan, OSM/Waymarked, transit feeds and field-report metadata.

Importer must transform EPSG:3006 official geometry to WGS84, assemble multi-part official lines, split/clip grouped features, reverse directions where needed, simplify geometry and apply endpoint-zone snapping policy.
Typed connector model must be implemented for boats, rowboats, ferry/water lines and road/bus transfers before runtime geometry is generated.
Facility taxonomy and deduplication must be applied to shared huts, shelters, bridges, toilets, help phones, shops, saunas, water, waste, viewpoints, Naturum, parking, lodging and village services.

Live currentness refresh is still required for trail/bridge notices, closures, fire bans, weather, hut seasons, boat operators, bus timetables, protected-area rules, reindeer/hunting/fishing and parking rules.
Generated app outputs and source hiking runtime data have intentionally not been edited.

openDecisions: Approve or reject runtime/source-policy use of Naturvardsverket/Lansstyrelsen state-trail geometry, Naturkartan API/GPX, OSM/Waymarked QA/fallback linework, transit feeds and field-report-derived metadata.
Decide whether the app import should support typed boat, rowboat, ferry/water and road/bus transfer connectors before Kungsleden is imported.
Decide whether access spurs such as Singi-Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta should remain access metadata only or become optional alternate route groups.
Decide the app taxonomy for hut clusters, child toilets, emergency phones, shops, saunas, waste points, water sources, bridges, viewpoints, Naturum, village services and parking.
Decide how much dynamic timetable/opening/currentness detail belongs in normalized data versus descriptions that require publication-date recheck.

Before publication/runtime import, recheck trail/bridge notices, closures, fire bans, weather, hut seasons, boat operators, bus timetables, protected-area rules, reindeer/hunting/fishing and parking rules.
